rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that there are countless or very many things.

example.english: There are myriad books in this library.
example.traditional: 呢間圖書館入面有無數本書。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 tou4 syu1 gun2 jap6 min6 jau5 mou4 sou3 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this before a classifier or noun for an emphatic large number, often with a written or literary feel rather than as a general equivalent of countless.

example.jyutping: sing6 wui6 kap1 jan5 maan6 jan4 dou3 coeng4

rows.note: Use this for things that come in many different types or have many varied aspects.

example.english: The online courses are myriad and varied, making it hard to choose.
example.traditional: 網上啲課程五花八門，真係揀到眼花。
example.jyutping: mong5 soeng6 di1 fo3 cing4 ng5 faa1 baat3 mun4 zan1 hai6 gaan2 dou2 ngaan5 faa1
